start: Phone joined to the gym as a member of the gym, number already matched; at the desk, the gym's check-in poster

steps.action: Scan the poster with the phone camera
user_sees: The app opens on 'Check in at <gym>'
'Tap Check in when you are at the gym.'
Buttons 'Check in' and 'Not now'
must_not: The member checked in just by opening the link
A browser page instead of the app

user_sees: 'Checking you in at <gym>…'
Then 'You're checked in at 6:42 pm'
'Checked in at <gym> as <name>. Have a good workout.'
must_not: Two visits recorded for one tap
'Your gym membership is not active today. Please see the desk.' for a plan that covers today

steps.action: Tap 'Start <today's routine>' (or 'Back to your workout' when one is open)
user_sees: The workout opens in place of the check-in
must_not: Back returning to a stale 'Start Push' card
The app closing on Back when opened cold from the poster

start: Gym tab, My gym part, at the desk

steps.action: Tap the row 'Check in' ('Scan the gym's check-in QR at the desk to mark today's visit')
user_sees: MettleUp's own scanner
must_not: A row that does nothing when the camera is refused

user_sees: 'Check in at <gym>' with the 'Check in' button
must_not: A check-in at another gym's poster with no word

user_sees: 'You're checked in at <time>'
must_not: The scanner staying open after the check-in

start: First check-in ever: the gym has no number matched to this phone

user_sees: 'Type the mobile number your gym has for you. The app asks only once.'
Box 'Your mobile number', placeholder '98290 12345'
must_not: Asked again on the next visit after a good check-in

user_sees: 'First check-in: go to the front desk and ask them to confirm your mobile number. When they say it is done, tap Check in below. You do this only once.'
must_not: The member checked in before the desk confirms the number

steps.action: The desk confirms; tap 'Check in' again
user_sees: 'You're checked in at <time>'
must_not: The number asked for a third time

start: Phone joined to another gym, scanning this gym's poster

user_sees: 'Finding your gym…'
'Check in at <poster gym>'
'This phone is joined to <my gym>, not <poster gym>. Join <poster gym> in the app first, then scan again.'
Buttons 'Join this gym' and 'Not now'
must_not: A check-in at a gym the member does not belong to
The phone silently switched to the poster's gym

user_sees: The Gym tab of the member's own gym
must_not: The app closing

start: First check-in, the number typed is wrong or short

user_sees: A red line asking for a valid mobile number, the box kept
must_not: A call to the server with 5 digits
The typed digits wiped

steps.action: Try several different numbers in a row
user_sees: 'Too many numbers were tried today. Check in at the desk, and ask them to check your mobile number.'
must_not: Unlimited guesses at other members' numbers

steps.action: Scan the poster again and tap 'Check in'
user_sees: 'You're checked in at <first time>'
'You were already checked in at <gym> today. Nothing more to do.'
must_not: A second visit counted for today
The time of the second scan shown as the check-in time

user_sees: The Gym tab
must_not: The check-in screen opening again on its own

start: A friend forwards the poster link into a WhatsApp group; the member opens it at home

user_sees: 'Check in at <gym>' and 'Tap Check in when you are at the gym.'
must_not: A check-in recorded just by opening the link
Another member's name on the screen

user_sees: The Gym tab; no visit recorded
must_not: A visit recorded for the day
